The passage describes Zoroastrian religious authority under the Sasanian Empire in the third century C.E., before the rise of Islam. Between 600 and 1450 C.E., the Sasanian Empire fell to the Arab Muslim conquests in the mid-seventh century, and Persia was gradually integrated into the Islamic world, coming under the political and cultural influence of the Caliphates and later other Muslim empires. This means Persia entered the Arabian orbit during this period.
